title: 全球债市看两家：美联储和日本央行，能否展示可信度
speaker: Michael Tang

segments.en: Within the spread space? Well, arguably, I think if, again, we're talking a big event here as well, I think a lot rest on the Fed.
segments.zh: 在利差空间？嗯，可以说，如果我们再次谈论重大事件，我认为很大程度上取决于美联储。

segments.en: I'd argue that there is probably a reasonably good chance to get into the flatness, but a big part of that is if the Fed can deliver a hike, show its credibility.
segments.zh: 我认为可能有相当好的机会进入平坦化交易，但很大一部分取决于美联储能否加息，展示其可信度。

segments.en: I think Japan, important as well next week, true to the biggest central banks in the world, if they can show their credibility, if they can show that they're willing to step in and find inflation, I think a big part of that will also give a lot of confidence to the long end of the bonfire.
segments.zh: 我认为日本下周也很重要，作为世界上最大的央行之一，如果他们能展示可信度，表明愿意介入并应对通胀，我认为这很大程度上也会给长端带来很多信心。

segments.en: So you'll have a bit of a repricing, I imagine, towards the front as investors expect more to be a jam, more Fed hikes across this year and into the next.
segments.zh: 所以我想，随着投资者预期今年到明年会有更多美联储加息，前端会出现一些重新定价。

segments.en: But importantly, it sends a strong signal about getting inflation down in the long end as well and not being beholden to the fiscal side of things.
segments.zh: 但重要的是，这发出了一个强烈信号，即长端也要降低通胀，并且不受财政方面的束缚。

segments.en: Yeah, I'm wondering, Michael, how you frame things in the morning, right? I mean, is it more that the treasure market is going to dictate what happens in the GGB market or is it going to be the other way?
segments.zh: 是的，Michael，我想知道你在早上是如何构建框架的？我的意思是，更多是美国国债市场决定GGB市场的走势，还是反过来？

segments.en: I mean, where do you turn to for direction now in this DM bond market?
segments.zh: 我的意思是，在这个发达市场债券市场中，你现在从哪里寻找方向？

segments.en: Ultimately, I think GGB is maybe a little bit more outside of my typical space. So to me, I think a lot of the time we still tend to watch the US a bit more, that's not to say Japan isn't important.
segments.zh: 最终，我认为GGB可能有点超出我的典型领域。所以对我来说，很多时候我们仍然倾向于更多地关注美国，这并不是说日本不重要。
